test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An article is sold for a profit of Rs. 180 . Profit percentage is 40 percent. What is the selling price of the article?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit % = 40% = 2/5 (where 2 units = Profit and 5 units = CP)

Given: 2 units = Rs. 180

⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 90

Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit = 5 + 2 = 7 units

⇒ SP = 7 × 90 = Rs. 630

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 630.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Profit = Rs. 180, Profit % = 40%

**Formula Used:** Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100 | Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81e35ebf95c1dbde2344790695c5b8280fd2109dadcda035847b59e213f5210a.png] 

⇒ Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100

⇒ 40 = (180 / CP) × 100

⇒ CP = (180 × 100) / 40

⇒ CP = 18000 / 40 = Rs. 450

⇒ SP = CP + Profit

⇒ SP = 450 + 180 = Rs. 630

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 630.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Basics

Profit occurs when SP > CP, and Loss occurs when CP > SP. Profit = SP − CP and Loss = CP − SP.

Direct SP Formula

SP = CP × (100 + Profit%)/100. In this case, SP = CP × 140/100.

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). SP = MP − Discount.
